title: Haan Mai bhi Azadaar hoon aur tum bhi
body:
Allah Allah - 6
Sajjad aur raahe shaam..
Haa...
Jab raahe shaam me thak kar ke
Pyaaso ka qafila baith gaya - 2
Sajjad bulakar Baqar ko
Dheeme dheeme yeh kehta tha...
Waada karo...
jabtak jiyenge..
maatam karenge..
